title.narrative: IOM Enhancing Resilience and Recovery in Mykolaiv Phase II

description.narrative: The project objective is to contribute to the resilience and recovery of war-affected communities in Mykolaivska Oblast is continuation of the current partnership initiated with the Denmark MFA on early recovery. The recovery and resilience interventions are in line with IOM Ukraine's Crisis Response Plan4 and will be achieved through a multi-sectoral and area-based approach, in close coordination and cooperation with the Mykolaiv local authorities. IOM will gather evidence on local recovery needs; rehabilitate and support the operation of critical medical and educational facilities; and contribute to the rehabilitation, operation and maintenance of water, sanitation and municipal heating facilities, infrastructure, and services in the targeted communities. IOM will provide sustenance support and contribute to the livelihood of individuals as well as support micro and small businesses to boost socio-economic opportunities and recovery conditions.
